// ./index.js
it("should preserve the resolution base for node-commonjs externals", async () => {
	const { relativeValue, packageValue } = await import("./chunks/lazy.mjs").then(__webpack_require__.t.bind(__webpack_require__, /*! ./lazy.cjs */ "./lazy.cjs", 19));

	expect(relativeValue).toBe(42);

	}
